task: N2.5 bounded model contract candidates and program binding
purpose: Use aligned architecture source to propose common-use obligations and conditional provider relations, then check source references and supported lexical relations. Do not manufacture preparation effects or a successful contrast pair.
registered_before: New packet preparation, model request, candidate-check implementation and output examination. Inputs are previously read known-case development material, not independent or blinded samples.

inputs.binding: Record exact input hashes and region text hashes before the single model request; every selected function retains profile, configuration, source and .i identity. Selected config facts are excerpts, absent keys are unknown rather than n.

model.refusal_policy: Preserve any refusal/incomplete result, do not continue the refused request, rewrite it to regain refused content, or count a later end_turn as complete.
model.credential: Existing external credential through process memory/environment only; never saved in project, ignored directories or packet.
model.accounting: Preserve CLI visible counters and reservation separately. Internal recovery and actual billing unknown; a CLI task is not guaranteed to be one upstream inference.

packet: 12 instrumented function regions (11 original plus the disclosed post-result supplementary region), selected actual config facts and generic task/schema instructions only. No old runtime values, failure/WARN verdicts, repair material, model labels, old manual provider features or independent oracle. Do not remove instrumented code. No requirement such as self membership is prefilled.
checks: Bind all evidence to exact numbered packet lines, original document/profile identity and byte digest. Reuse the established preprocessed lexer for explicitly requested lexical_call_order claims; validate real call-shaped identifier tokens, unique anchors and relative source position. Lexical order is not CFG order, reachability, callee effects or readiness. Other provider/guard/object/authority claims require independent bounded source review, not automatic approval. Do not modify the original N2 contract or fill formal features.
validation: Meaningful citation/identity/call-token boundaries and the actual unchanged model output, no format retry or hand correction. Independent source oracle prepared separately without the new model answer; final review distinguishes new extraction, manual interpretation and unresolved conditions.
exit: Complete one packet/request/binding/semantic-review loop. Save raw and final output, delivery/usage, program results, supported and rejected claims, next concrete task and synchronized notes. If no complete final, record that limit without another call.
